changelog:
Initial release of the sales-enablement skill, focused on practical sales collateral creation and best practices.

- Guides users in creating sales decks, one-pagers, objection handling docs, demo scripts, and sales playbooks.
- Provides detailed frameworks and templates for each asset type.
- Stresses rep involvement, scannability, and outcome-based messaging.
- Outlines value prop gathering, sales motion, collateral needs, and audit questions before starting.
- Includes segment-specific guidance for different buyer personas and deal stages.
summary: When the user wants to create sales collateral, pitch decks, one-pagers, objection handling docs, or demo scripts. Also use when the user mentions 'sales deck,' 'pitch deck,' 'one-pager,' 'leave-behind,' 'objection handling,' 'deal-specific ROI analysis,' 'demo script,' 'talk track,' 'sales playbook,' 'proposal template,' 'buyer persona card,' 'help my sales team,' 'sales materials,' or 'what should I give my sales reps.' Use this for any document or asset that helps a sales team close deals. For competitor comparison pages and battle cards, see competitors. For marketing website copy, see copywriting. For cold outreach emails, see cold-email. For the offer being sold (bonuses, guarantees, pricing structure), see offers.
